Movies22.name: Movies22
Movies22.description: Movies22 is the current Server Technician and the one responsible for the metro's automation, HS1 and maintaining the bot and its various integrations. He joined the OP team on the 24th July 2022 and was promoted to ST on the 31st January 2023 after his technical contributions to both metro and HS1.

Supa101.name: Supa101
Supa101.description: Supa101 is the current governor for Ailsbury, as well as the one responsible for Ailsbury Connect. He became a Village Governor after the Cashcraft Change Plans made Ailsbury an indepedent village (it was previously apart of Fernhill). Supa has contributed massively to the server since Ailsbury's independence, creating Ailsbury Connect, great extensions and even a small area within its village (Honton Town) to immortalize Ailsbury's origins.

cameforthecash.name: cameforthecash
cameforthecash.description:
Cash is the founder and owner of Cashcraft.
That's all lol

SquadFam9000.name: SquadFam9000
SquadFam9000.description: Squad is the current New Arbridge's Governor, Community and Land manager and HS2/GAR manager. He's done massive contributions to the server, such as the Airport, modernizing metro/heavy rail standards, coming up with new decorations (that eventually spread to other villages) and much more. He's also the one responsible for the Community Feedback, Event Planners, Hamlets (which replaced Project Areas) and, more recently, Transparency Guidelines.

Arcoda.name: Arcoda
Arcoda.description: Arcoda was the former Server Technician (though she still works behind the scenes). She has done multiple contributions to the server such as the CashCraft SMP, the Arcoda/Cash bots, the Cash plugin (to manage plugins), keeping the server updated and well, as well as renovating it!

DwellerUK.name: DwellerUK
DwellerUK.description: Dweller was the former Land manager for CashCraft. He was responsible for, along with Cash, managing the village's land, as well as the moderation system. He's also a great graphic designer, being the one formerly behind the HS1 and Metro network maps (and the former CNRN network map).

JackG_UK.name: JackG_UK
JackG_UK.description: Jack is a former Village Governor who has done considerable contributions to the server. From a technical point of view, he's a great coder who contributed to the server's plugins in the past. He's currently a Server Operator and one of the SVR managers.

Boowan.name: Boowan
Boowan.description: Boowan is the current Village Governor for Hemstead after winning the elections in August 2022. He's the owner of Cash's cocaine/Cash's Crack, a brand that's in pretty much every hidden corner of the map. He's also one of the two managers for SVR.

DCGaming001.name: DCGaming001
DCGaming001.description: DCGaming was a former Server Operator. He was responsible for building "Escapro" in Fernhill: a group of minigames where the goal was to escape the area. He was also the technician guy for Callum's metro back in the day, resigning because of the way he was treated by Callum/Logic.

NoahReijnen.name: NoahReijnen
NoahReijnen.description: NoahReijnen was the former Engagement Manager and Elderville Governor. He passed the duty of governing Elderville to Vex_SG in July, getting promoted back to EM as a result. He was also one of the people behind the original CashCraft metro (made by Callum). He got demoted from EM due to inactivity, being replaced by Squad, but came back to the Staff Team last year as an Event Planner.

Emeralds6s.name: Emeralds6s
Emeralds6s.description: Cashcraft Veteran in the server in terms of lore has seen the entire world of cashcraft expand and also Films and streams there!

FedererTDLB.name: FedererTDLB
FedererTDLB.description: Friendly guy :) Founder and owner of Conad and hamlet developer of Warham.

redrestone01.name: redrestone01
redrestone01.description:
Did I ever tell you the story of redredstone on this server? If not then let's get right to it.
It all started on the 6th of February when his application was accepted and joined cashcraft, from that point on he was relatively active for like a month. Then for the next few months silence, and it seemed like he moved on. But after a while he was online again and can be seen messing around in his lab that isn't in its original location anymore. He went back to silence then somehow got a "friend" (since he is a degenerate loser who spends most of his time on discord and can't actually make friends) named Movies22. They would sometimes chat and then an SMP was created by Arcoda. There an alliance was formed between redstone, movies and supa known as the 3k block base. Oh yeah and he committed some war crimes on day one of the smp and wanted to start a communist party but we don't talk about that. The 3k block base would go on to form the group CashCraft Commonwealth with the help of some others. The construction of a high speed train connection was taking place when suddenly... the smp was reset, all the progress was lost and the alliance was broken up. After that he wouldn't be online for quite a while sometimes logging on to do some building on the SMP but that all ended when he asked to be teleported out of the smp and he could no longer return. The second season of the smp ended there. After all that, he decided to focus on a Roblox group that had a bit of drama (cough All Change). Once he came back from the dead he saw an opportunity to make a system for tracking trains that were controlled by TC2 (or he-who-shall-not-be-named as movies knows it). He began working on a prototype and it went pretty well. After about 3 days a version was ready and can be used to generate maps that are geographically correct, and thats is where the story ends as parts of the story are still being discovered.
